title: Fix release-plz workflow (403 opening PR) for GitFlow releases from main

comments.author: home
comments.text: Diagnosis (attempt A): every Release workflow run since repo creation fails with release-plz 'Failed to open PR' — HTTP 403 Forbidden on POST /repos/AnthusAI/BotSpy/pulls. Root cause: repo setting 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' is disabled (can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false), so GITHUB_TOKEN cannot open PRs even though the workflow declares pull-requests: write. Side effect: 46 stale release-plz-* branches pushed to remote (one per failed run) with no PR attached. Fix: enable the repo setting; workflow also gets workflow_dispatch trigger and optional RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN secret fallback. Board changes committed straight to develop per instructions.
